method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module, shared rules and one regulative rule (a step to be taken within the days the Act allows, run by EVALTRACE inside two exported questions that take only plain facts) in a rules module, the employee's questions in a seat module; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Industrial Relations Act 1979 (WA), No. 114 of 1979, compilation to the Industrial Relations Legislation Amendment Act 2024 (No. 43 of 2024, ss 100-103 from 1 September 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49816.txt (text sha256 e6d52776af326e7d7acad964e5f3cc73b8f081e019853738b1a7a85046c37ba3), retrieved from legislation.wa.gov.au on 2026-09-07; with the Industrial Relations (General) Regulations 1997 rr 5-7 and Schedule 4 (version 01-h0-00, from 23 January 2025)

seat: the employee: the individual employee of an employer in the WA state system (an employer that is not a national system employer, or a local government declared under s 80A), and for Part II Division 3AA the worker who is bullied or the person sexually harassed in connection with work (ira-employee.l4)
focus: the state system for non-constitutional-corporation employers: the provisions a claimant meets

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run ira-dates.l4 ; l4 run ira-rules.l4 ; l4 run ira-employee.l4 ; l4 run ira-cases.l4
checks.result: 159 assertions written, 159 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
